description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Construction of NHERI TallWood Test Structure: From Tree to Tower is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Joel Conte, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This research is a detailed summary of the relationship between NHERI TallWood and the mass timber industry. The NHERI TallWood is unique as it is a 10-story mass timber structure that will be tested for seismic resilience of high-rise timber structures. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-74fn-yw41. Keywords: LHPOST, NHERI TallWood, mass timber, seismic resilience, BIM. Published 2022-08-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
